review.en: Twenty-three prose poems and a foreword, written in a small Beijing study between 1924 and 1926. Dreams, graves, frozen fire and an autumn night under two jujube trees: this is Lu Xun at his most private and most modern. Some pieces remain hard to decode, which is part of their pull. The Open Stacks hold six of them.
review.zh: 二十三篇散文诗加一篇题辞，写于北京西三条胡同的小书房。梦、坟、死火、后园的两株枣树，这是鲁迅最私密、也最现代的一面。有些篇章至今难以索解，这也正是它的吸引力。开架书库收有其中六篇。
